verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at learn.chatgpt.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). The documentation pages are themselves served as Markdown (.md URLs such as use-chatgpt.md and extend/mcp.md), giving agents clean, agent-readable docs to point at. The .md.md 404 is just a doubled-extension probe and does not count against this. Missing for 10: the llms.txt is headed and scoped to Codex rather than the broader ChatGPT product, there is no first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or Markdown-docs offering for agents, and there is no independent community corroboration of agents using it.
